sources.title: Which Training Intensity Distribution Intervention will Produce the Greatest Improvements in Maximal Oxygen Uptake and Time-Trial Performance in Endurance Athletes?
sources.note_sr: U individualnoj meta-analizi nisu nađene univerzalne prednosti polarizovanog modela; nivo sportiste menja odgovor.

sources.title: Comparison of Polarized Versus Other Types of Endurance Training Intensity Distribution on Athletes’ Endurance Performance
sources.note_sr: Polarizovani model je bio povoljniji za VO2peak u nekim podgrupama, ali ne i univerzalno za sve performanse.

sources.title: Effect of Strength Training Programs in Middle- and Long-Distance Runners’ Economy at Different Running Speeds
sources.note_sr: Trening snage može poboljšati ekonomiju trčanja; efekat zavisi od metode i brzine.

sources.title: The Association Between Running Injuries and Training Parameters: A Systematic Review
sources.note_sr: Dokazi o treninzima i povredama su neujednačeni; univerzalno pravilo povećanja za 10% nije opravdano.

sources.title: The Effect of Strength Training on Endurance Performance Determinants in Middle- and Long-Distance Endurance Athletes: An Umbrella Review
sources.note_sr: Pregledi nalaze koristi za ekonomiju trčanja, bez jasnog poboljšanja VO2max.
